guideSummary.surfnerd: Wickaninnish is a friendly sand-bottom beachbreak at the southern end of Long Beach, spread along a big, wide, flat beach strewn with driftwood. It sits right next to hotels, trails, viewpoints and the Wickaninnish Centre for the Pacific Rim National Park, so it doubles as an easy stop for anyone already staying nearby. Sheltered from south winds and forgiving in the water, it's a good place to learn.
